| [TERM-089](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-089.md) v2 | apparatus, in the operational sense: a realized organization that selectively couples differences in one system to distinguishable outcomes in another; by function it may differentiate, retain, enforce and revise, and the four come apart | The sense of "apparatus" the exchange of 2026-10-27 converged on from U19 to U23, stated so that no observer and no constitutive metaphysics is presupposed. An apparatus makes some differences in a system produce distinct outcomes in another (differentiation), and may keep them (retention), let them change what happens next (enforcement), and change its own criteria of discrimination (revision). Proposed: the record uses "apparatus" in [CLAIM-476](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-476.md) and [TERM-087](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-087.md) in Barad's sense, and needed a weaker one that a thermometer, a bacterium, a sensor network and luria all fall under without argument. | Active |
| [TERM-091](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-091.md) v2 | relational vocabulary, of a class of descriptions: the arities and kinds of relation it can state (pairwise or higher-order, among states or among histories, of which declared types), and so which constraints are expressible in it at all | What [QUESTION-283](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-283.md) asks about: whether composition can force a description to adopt relations its parts never needed. A sheaf on a graph has a pairwise vocabulary. Eliminating an interior can leave a constraint outside it ([THEORY-1090](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1090.md)). A luria record's relational vocabulary is its declared relation types and fields, and amendments that add one ([ADR-043](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-043.md), [ADR-044](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-044.md)) enlarge it.
